question: Who among the following won a Gold Medal at the 2021 World Cadet Wrestling Championship held in Budapest, Hungary?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Priya Malik**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Priya Malik won the Gold Medal in the **World Cadet Wrestling Championship** held in Budapest, Hungary in 2021.
 
• She competed in the **73 kg category**.
 
• Her victory came shortly after India's **Neeraj Chopra** won a gold medal in javelin at the Tokyo Olympics, raising the country's spirits.
 
• Priya Malik's win is significant as it demonstrates the growing prowess of Indian wrestlers on the world stage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **World Cadet Wrestling Championship**

 
 
• This championship is an international wrestling competition for athletes aged 16-17 years.
 
• It is organized by the **United World Wrestling (UWW)**, the international governing body for the sport of amateur wrestling.
 
• The event features various weight categories for both male and female wrestlers.
 
• The championship aims to provide a platform for young wrestlers to showcase their talent and gain international experience.
 
 
 
• **United World Wrestling (UWW)**
 
 
• UWW is the international governing body for the sport of wrestling, overseeing wrestling disciplines such as Freestyle, Greco-Roman, and Beach Wrestling.
 
• It was founded in 1912 and is headquartered in **Corsier-sur-Vevey, Switzerland**.
 
• UWW organizes various international competitions, including the World Wrestling Championships, Continental Championships, and the Olympic Games wrestling events.
 
• The organization is committed to promoting and developing the sport of wrestling globally, ensuring fair play and adherence to the rules.
 
 
 
• **Indian Wrestlers on the Global Stage**
 
 
• India has a rich history in wrestling, with the sport being one of the oldest and most popular in the country.
 
• Indian wrestlers have made significant strides on the international stage, winning medals in events such as the Olympics, Asian Games, Commonwealth Games, and World Championships.
 
• Notable Indian wrestlers include **Sushil Kumar**, **Bajrang Punia**, **Vinesh Phogat**, and **Sakshi Malik**.
 
• The success of wrestlers like Priya Malik highlights the continued growth and potential of Indian wrestling on the global stage.
